description: An inline use child whose own YAML parses but isn't a mapping, under both validate: true (the 'Inline orchestration validation failed:' wrapper around the same message) and validate: false (the bare message, no wrapper) -- on_error: skip absorbs both so the exact text is inspectable in the final state. A YAML *parse* error's own text is deliberately not used here: PyYAML's and electricity's own YAML parser's error messages differ (compared by source location, not text, per the issue), so a parse-error case would need engine-specific expected text this harness's single-location known_divergence can't express.
